ValidationRule.description: Prevents the agent from saving the Recipient/Mule record if all the mandatory fields are not populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "Recipient_Mule", NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type, "")), NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Not a Recipient") ), OR( ISBLANK(Fraud_Detection_Case_Reference__c), ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Fraud_Received__c), Fraud_Total_Fraud_Received__c < 0, ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Recovered__c), Fraud_Total_Recovered__c < 0, ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Customer_Exposure__c), Fraud_Total_Customer_Exposure__c < 0, ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Loss_Reason_Code__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(RecipientFundsType__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Detection Case Reference, Total Fraud Received, Total Recovered, Loss Reason Code, Total Customer Exposure, Recipient Funds Type
